run_phyre_viz_server: run the phyre visualization server by executing server.py as a script entry point
run_server_with_port: run the phyre viz server on a custom port by passing --port argument
run_server_with_mode: run the phyre viz server in demo dev or prod mode using the --mode flag
review_server_entry_point: review the server.py entry point that delegates to phyre.viz_server.server.main
summarize_server_module: summarize the server.py module which imports and calls the viz server main function
